commands.name: Move Plunger Relative
commands.note: The pump checks the range: an out-of-range channel returns 28 while the other channels still move. Read RDS after 28. Unit is FULL steps (SEP/SPP/STP speeds are in half steps).

commands.name: Move Plunger to Absolute Position
commands.note: Same partial-execution behaviour as PPR on error 28.

commands.name: Move Tracking Relative
commands.note: Z tracking distance from STZ, Z speed from SSZ. Without plunger parameters nothing moves. Invalid Z value: error 3, no move. Invalid plunger value: Z and the other plungers move, the invalid channel does not, error 28. In 8+1 only the first parameter counts.

commands.name: Initialize Plunger and Valve Drive (Reverse Polarity)
commands.note: Resets all speeds and ramps to default afterwards. In 8+1 DilutorSelect is always 1. The table of contents OCR reads it as 'PIO'.

commands.name: Start Hit Pinch Valve Solenoids
commands.note: Timing set by the XP2000 commands SBH, STH and SAH, which would need the excluded T pass-through.

commands.name: Start Piezo Pump for N Drops
commands.note: Pulse count and pump settings from XP2000 SPN, SPV, SPF and SPW.

commands.name: Dispense Volume
commands.note: Uses XP2000 SPV, SPF, SPW, SOV, SDV and SYV. Syringe size must be 10..1000 uL.
